results.title: Canada Holidays Act section 2 Canada Day Sunday
highlights: Canada Day Marginal note: Canada Day 2 (1) July 1, not being a Sunday, is a legal holiday and shall be kept and observed as such throughout Canada under the name of " Canada Day ". Marginal note: When July 1 is a Sunday (2) When July 1 is a Sunday, July 2 is a legal holiday and shall be kept and observed as such throughout Canada under the name of " Canada Day ". R.S., c. H-7, s. 2
